name: Scribeberry
description: Scribeberry is an AI medical scribe trusted by 30,000+ providers with transparent pricing: Free tier (20 uses/month after 3-day unlimited trial), Pro at $99/month unlimited, Enterprise from $79/user/month with volume discounts. Claims 99.9% accuracy and finishing charting in 2 minutes instead of 20. HIPAA and PIPEDA compliant—works internationally (Canada focus). Works with every EMR via copy-paste or integration. Ambient scribe, dictation, templates, and forms included in Pro tier. ROI math: $99/mo vs $35,000/year human scribe = break-even by day 12.

faqs.q: How much does Scribeberry cost in 2026?
faqs.a: Scribeberry offers a free tier (3-day unlimited trial, then 20 uses/month), Pro at $99/month unlimited, and Enterprise from $79/user/month with volume discounts. No credit card required for free tier.

faqs.q: Does Scribeberry have a free tier?
faqs.a: Yes. After a 3-day unlimited trial, Scribeberry offers 20 free uses per month indefinitely. No credit card required. Pro tier ($99/mo) is unlimited.

faqs.q: Is Scribeberry PIPEDA compliant for Canadian practices?
faqs.a: Yes. Scribeberry is both HIPAA and PIPEDA compliant, making it suitable for Canadian healthcare practices with privacy requirements.
Scribeberry claims 99.9% accuracy with charting completed in 2 minutes instead of 20 minutes manually.

faqs.q: Scribeberry vs Freed: which is better?
faqs.a: Both cost $99/mo for Pro tier. Scribeberry has Canadian PIPEDA compliance and a generous free tier (20/month). Freed starts at $39/mo and is stronger in US market. For Canadian practices, Scribeberry. For budget-conscious US practices, Freed.
